channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-smart-tv
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Optics — via awesome-smart-tv
item.description: Test automation for Android TV, Samsung Tizen and LG webOS apps through Appium, with tests written as CSV or YAML steps that press remote-control keys and check the screen by text, OCR or image. Also runs on Android, iOS and web (python).

item.title: go-webos — via awesome-smart-tv
item.description: A small Go library for interaction with webOS TVs (golang).

item.title: ares-webos-sdk — via awesome-smart-tv
item.description: webOS CLI as separate NPM module (JavaScript).

item.title: TizenTube — via awesome-smart-tv
item.description: A TizenBrew module that enhances your favourite streaming websites viewing experience by removing ads and adding support for Sponsorblock.

item.title: TizenBrew — via awesome-smart-tv
item.description: A way to experience modded websites and you can install newer apps without fighting with Tizen Studio

item.title: Invidious Tizen — via awesome-smart-tv
item.description: An Invidious client for Samsung Tizen TVs via TizenBrew, with D-pad navigation and full remote-control support (TypeScript).
